snippet.title: Jotun Predator - Available Now in Predator: Hunting Grounds
snippet.description:
Our second warrior from Predator: Killer of Killers has entered the Hunting Grounds.

Armed with the crushing Shock Gauntlet, the Jotun Predator eliminates foes with the fury of the gods.

Experience this not-so-gentle giant today: https://predator.illfonic.com/news/patch-notes-3-6-0
